scope: Current source backend and actual pinned Mermaid parser; final browser and 2.3 relocated/native release gates remain separate.

parser.reverseRepresentation: Swapped generated node aliases with a forward arrow; model owner and persisted endpoints unchanged.

checks: SVG uses correctly oriented start and end markers for four directions.
Supported source-model arrows map without changing stored owner or endpoint identities.
A bound interaction with a known mismatched arrow is rejected before staging.
Unsupported model arrows remain unchanged and produce a visible warning.
Invalid diagram arrow values and types are rejected.
Old directed and undirected diagram definitions remain valid.
Actual generated Markdown/Mermaid text parses with the pinned portal parser for all four directions.
limitations: Mermaid 11.16.1 rejects a bare left-pointing link, so reverse output swaps generated aliases and uses a forward arrow; source and saved diagram identities do not change.
This source followup does not assert that a rebuilt 2.3 distribution, browser acceptance, deployment or remote publication has completed.
privacy: Only counters, check descriptions, supported direction values, relative receipt paths and file digests; no local absolute paths or raw source models.
